result.question: Why did God cause the leaders of Shechem to treat Abimelech deceitfully?
result.answer: So that the crime against Jerubbaal’s seventy sons might come to justice and their blood be avenged.
result.reason: The passage says God caused the leaders of Shechem to treat Abimelech deceitfully; it does not merely say he allowed it. The repaired wording preserves the original subject and intended fact and is directly answered by verses 9:23–24.
